environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running Node.js 18 monolith in us-east-1a, deployed in a public subnet with an Internet Gateway attached. Security group allows inbound TCP/3000 from 0.0.0.0/0. No rate limiting, no WAF, no load balancer. The application is directly internet-facing via the instance's public IPv4 address. Single-threaded Node.js event loop with default configuration (no worker threads, no cluster mode).
